tldr:
For the integrated causal cause-one risk contrast, the complete original marked current-status class has matching minimax RMSE and 90 percent honest expected-length orders
\[R_n(\beta)\asymp L_n(\beta)\asymp n^{-1/2}\vee n^{-4\beta/(4\beta+5)},\qquad 0<\beta\le2.\]
The root-\(n\) precision region is \([5/4,2]\), including a log-free equality case. Explicit original-record spline pilots and quadratic corrections attain these orders; legal linked event/reporting alternatives provide separate loss and coverage converses. The law-level reporting boundary is different: at independent-potential completions, the canonical score uses the origin-weighted energy \(\mathcal E_{\mathrm{rep}}\), giving distinct origin and interior cusp thresholds and a positive same-law comparison when reporting is known. At arbitrary full-law completions, finite energy gives sufficiency and a variance upper bound. Latent couplings can change the canonical variance without changing the observed records, so universal canonical efficient attainment and consistent studentization are impossible at every \(\beta\), and \(\mathcal B_{\mathrm{joint}}=\varnothing\). Birg\'e--Massart and Laurent receive credit for the generic scalar exponent, smoothness elbow and correction machinery. The weighted-stability result follows from the total finite-grid pilot and trained quadratic-envelope results, including both endpoint cells and finite Borel integration. This note does not determine pointwise efficient attainment or critical compatibility for a selected latent completion or a restricted observable/primitive-path tangent model; those cases lie outside the proved universal full-law obstruction.
